note: Village of Val Marie campground, grassed and shaded, a short walk from the cafe, museum, store and the Grasslands National Park visitor centre; spray park beside the sites. Sites 1-4 have 15-amp power that won't run an air conditioner; book 5-13 for A/C. --Claude

flags: SITES: stored 17 (no source) -> 13 (Let's Camp list and site map).

HOOKUPS: stored water true -> false and sewer added false: every site type reads 'Central water tap available at washroom building'; dump station on site. Electric 50 (sites 7-13 15+50 A; 5-6 15+30 A; 1-4 15 A, no A/C).
RIG LENGTH: Let's Camp gives maxRvLength 59-60 ft on every site but pad lengths of 24-40 ft (sites 2, 4, 6 at 24 ft); max_rig left unset. A 23-ft rig fits every site.

PIN: recommend move. Stored 49.24720,-107.72765 sits on a residential street at the north edge of the village (houses, no campground). Google's place pin 49.2428,-107.7318 (~570 m SW) falls on a treed block with a grassed centre west of the village, bounded by roads, matching 'grassed with lots of trees'. Esri imagery predates the spray park, so the loop can't be confirmed from above; target 49.2428,-107.7318 - reviewer may want a second look.
WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' confirmed (in-village; Frenchman River well east).
SEASON: stored 05-01..10-31 (approximate) -> 05-01..10-13 (operator's 2027 season). 'Closed for the 2026 season' is the normal off-season.
BOOKING: fcfs left unset - Let's Camp rules say 'All sites are to be booked and paid for online', but the Village page accepts walk-ins who may be moved.
